titulo: The recipe card beside the pot
caption:
The recipe card beside the pot

The card lay flat on the counter. She raised it up beside the pot, and the steps were in view.

A recipe in your line of sight gets read at every step, not only the first one.

For whoever keeps the recipe in view while they cook.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a long counter. A recipe card titled Soup lies low on the counter and a pot with steam stands at the right. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the card hops up high above the counter, right next to the pot, with a small sparkle. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: I'll remember the steps, to: recipe up where I can see it.
